searchText: Hi! I am a research engineer at a crypto asset management firm based in SF. I am trying to learn more about what Ethereum is today and where it will be in the future! Hi guys I'm a blockchain core developer at PDAO & blockchain researcher from Seoul. My research interests are blockchain storages, blockchain core and I'm currently interested in Verkle Trees. Nice to meet you here, one of your followers! Your contents are super intuitive!!
